title: ExtractRequest
description: Propose provisional KnowledgeEntry candidates from referenced source material; returns ExtractResponse.

run_id.description: Non-empty opaque caller-supplied correlation identity for this extraction batch. Echoed verbatim in ExtractResponse run.run_id; not a durable run record.

sources.description: Non-empty referenced source list. Extraction range is this list plus each anchor's optional span (absent span = the referenced artifact as a whole). No inline-content field.

entry_types.description: Optional candidate-type hints. Advisory open vocabulary — not a closed taxonomy and not a post-filter.
